---
title: "Parameter Inference"
subtitle: "Population and patient-level posterior distributions"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("_setup.R")
noise_sd   <- pub_tar_read("all_tumor_ssls_noise_sd_rvar")
coef_names <- colnames(pub_tar_read("covar_design_matrix"))

# Build coef data inline — the pre-built target only has _01 variants but CRC
# also has _02, _12, _03 transitions. as_draws_rvars() is fast on draws_array.
.make_coef <- function(draws, fit_type) {
  pat     <- "^(frac_coef_qr_pop|init_coef_qr_pop|(time_invariant|time_varying)_coef_qr)"
  coef_rv <- posterior::as_draws_rvars(draws)
  coef_rv <- coef_rv[grepl(pat, names(coef_rv))]
  purrr::imap_dfr(coef_rv, \(v, nm) {
    tibble::tibble(.variable = nm, n = seq_along(v), .value = v,
                   covariate = coef_names[n], fit_type = fit_type)
  })
}

coef_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .make_coef(pub_tar_read("tumor_ssls_draws_pop_prior"),     "prior"),
  .make_coef(pub_tar_read("tumor_ssls_draws_pop_posterior"), "posterior")
)

# Rebuild rates_rvar fresh from draws_pop, using only scalar pop params.
# Cannot use the pre-built all_tumor_ssls_rates_rvar target because
# tr_sd_level_intercept[1,2] is indexed, forcing the whole .value column to a
# list-of-rvars which ggdist cannot render.
.scalar_vars <- c("tr_loc_pop", "frac_logit_loc_pop",
                  "pop_log_decrease_rate", "pop_log_growth_rate")
.make_rates <- function(draws, fit_type) {
  draws |>
    posterior::subset_draws(variable = .scalar_vars) |>
    tidybayes::gather_rvars(tr_loc_pop, frac_logit_loc_pop,
                            pop_log_decrease_rate, pop_log_growth_rate) |>
    dplyr::mutate(fit_type = fit_type)
}
rates_rvar <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .make_rates(pub_tar_read("tumor_ssls_draws_pop_prior"),     "prior"),
  .make_rates(pub_tar_read("tumor_ssls_draws_pop_posterior"), "posterior")
)
```

## Population-Level Rates {#sec-pop-rates}

```{r}
#| label: fig-pop-rates
#| fig-cap: Population-level log growth and regression rates — prior vs posterior.

rates_rvar |>
  plot_prior_post_dens(.value, normalize = "groups") +
  labs(x = "") +
  facet_wrap(vars(.variable), scales = "free",
             labeller = labeller(.variable = \(l) str_remove(l, "log_"))) +
  NULL
```

## Measurement Noise {#sec-noise}

```{r}
#| label: fig-noise-sd
#| fig-cap: Measurement noise SD (SLD observation error) — prior vs posterior.

noise_sd |>
  plot_prior_post_hist(normalize = "groups") +
  labs(x = "Measurement SD") +
  NULL
```

## Covariate Effects {#sec-covariate-effects}

```{r}
#| label: fig-covariate-effects
#| fig-cap: Covariate coefficient posterior distributions (QR-space).

coef_data |>
  filter(fit_type == "posterior") |>
  ggplot() +
  stat_pointinterval(aes(xdist = .value, y = covariate, color = .variable),
                     .width = c(0.5, 0.9)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_discrete("Parameter", type = AZ_palette) +
  labs(x = "Coefficient (QR space)", y = "") +
  NULL
```
